explanation: Textbook fact (Cox, Primes of the form x² + ny², Thm 2.8 with the Dirichlet/Gauss correspondence): for square-free D ≡ 3 (mod 4), −D is a fundamental discriminant and h(ℚ(√−D)) equals the number of reduced primitive positive-definite forms of discriminant −D. IsReducedForm encodes b² − 4ac = −D, |b| ≤ a ≤ c, gcd(a, b, c) = 1 and b ≥ 0 when |b| = a or a = c (positivity of a follows). Correct statement of a standard result.
